name: japan-da-man
description: japan-da-man's Claude Code plugins and mods

plugins.name: japan-da-man-mods
plugins.description: [bundle] Installs every japan-da-man plugin at once: todo-mod, token-weather, usage-stats, blast-radius, replay-theater, spec-flow and mod-dev

plugins.name: todo-mod
plugins.description: [mod] TODO pane: check a task to have Claude run it

plugins.name: token-weather
plugins.description: [mod] A live forecast of the context window above the prompt: weather icon, fill, tokens, a chart of the last turns and how much the last turn added. Based on Anthropic's claude-code-playground mod

plugins.name: usage-stats
plugins.description: [mod] Usage stats pane: sessions, messages, tokens, active days, streak, favorite model and a daily heatmap

plugins.name: mod-dev
plugins.description: [skills] Skills for building Claude Code mods: scaffold, test and register a new mod in a plugin marketplace repo or on its own

plugins.name: blast-radius
plugins.description: [mod] Holds risky shell commands (rm -rf, git reset --hard, force push, git clean, migrations, find -delete, xargs rm, also inside bash -c / eval) and shows what they would change in a pane with Proceed / Cancel. Based on Anthropic's claude-code-playground mod

plugins.name: replay-theater
plugins.description: [mod] Records the file edits Claude makes in a turn; /replay or r steps through the diffs one at a time in a pane. Based on Anthropic's claude-code-playground mod

plugins.name: spec-flow
plugins.description: [mod] [skills] Turns a feature request into a spec, one approved step at a time: clarify the request (asking you what is unclear), survey every affected screen and feature with subagents, write the requirements, then propose several feature and UI options with mockups. Saved under docs/specs/; /specs shows the checklist
